thread:
alex: Quick FYI — during this oncall window I'm going to split low-noise alerts out of #eng-oncall into #eng-oncall-low so paging only hits high-severity alerts. Also adjusting the 'HighCPU' Prometheus rule short-burst threshold from 85% -> 90% and `for` of 1m -> 2m. Will open a PR in ~10m. @maria can you cover if pages land? If no ack by 10m I'll proceed.

maria: Ack — I can cover 02:00-06:00 UTC. I'll also mute #eng-oncall-low on my phone and keep an eye on the high channel.

jon: Can you paste the Alertmanager route change & prometheus snippet? Curious about `group_wait`/`group_interval` changes and rollback plan.

alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/789
Config snippet I'm going to apply (staging first):
```yaml
route:
  receiver: 'oncall-high'
  matchers:
    severity: 'critical'
  continue: false
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 1h
receivers:
- name: 'oncall-high'
  webhook_configs:
    - url: 'https://hooks.internal/redwood/oncall-high'
```
Prometheus rule change:
```yaml
- alert: HighCPU
  expr: avg_over_time(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!='idle'}[3m]) > 0.90
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: critical
  annotations:
    summary: "High CPU usage on {{ $labels.instance }}"
```
Rollback plan: revert PR + fast-deploy revert job + notify #eng-oncall. I'll watch for 15m after merge.

pat: Two quick Qs: (1) any chance this breaks current deduping/group_by logic? (2) will the oncall bot still post to the main channel for visibility (non-pager)?

alex: 1) shouldn't — group_by remains the same (instance, alertname). 2) yes, adding a `notify_non_pager` receiver that posts to #eng-oncall with a non-pager webhook so visibility is retained. Example included in PR.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: infra/alertmanager config PR #789 merged by alex — starting rollout to staging at 1771234575

maria: If I get paged and it's low-noise, I'll escalate to jon after 10m. Adding a short note in the oncall handoff doc: "split routing test; alex merged change; maria backup 02:00-06:00"

jon: Sounds good. Quick ask — can we lower `repeat_interval` to 30m for infra-critical alerts (only) to avoid long backlog in notification systems? Might help for noisy flapping.

alex: I'll limit `repeat_interval: 30m` to infra-critical alerts in the PR patch and keep the rest at 1h. If it creates noise we'll revert. Proceeding with merge in 5m unless objections.

pat: :+1:

alex: Merged and watching. Handoff to @maria at 02:00 UTC. Tagging this thread for follow-up/debrief tomorrow morning if we see unintended pages.
